Figure 3: Ablation results showing the contribution of different detectors to final accuracy. Each group compares four routing settings: no detector, only the stuck detector, only the milestone detector, and both detectors enabled.

Figure 2: Quantitative failure signatures of small-policy trajectories. (a) Failed episodes are substantially longer than successful ones, indicating prolonged unproductive execution. (b) Failed episodes exhibit markedly higher action repetition rates, consistent with progress stalls. (c) A non-trivial fraction of failures terminate with a model-issued done, revealing silent semantic drift.
